brief:
Yair Lapid has accused Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of contradicting himself regarding warnings about the elections, Ma'an Wire reported. Lapid said Netanyahu told people not to spread panic about the electoral process while simultaneously making cautionary statements about the vote.

The Israeli opposition figure's comments reflect ongoing tensions between Netanyahu and political rivals over messaging around the electoral campaign and its implications.

title: Lapid accuses Netanyahu of contradicting himself on election warnings
